statements.f1: The Pass scheduling API primary host is qrv-nemora.qrv.invalid. Mission-operations consoles use it to read confirmed contact windows.
statements.f2: On 2026-03-12, the Pass scheduling API primary host changed to qrv-iskara.qrv.invalid after the previous host developed intermittent connection resets.

topics.query: What is the current primary host for the Pass scheduling API?

statements.f1: The TLE ingest gateway landing bucket is qrv-tle-mavrin. Incoming element files land there before parsing and source validation.
statements.f2: On 2026-02-18, the TLE ingest gateway landing bucket changed to qrv-track-selin because the previous bucket's event notifications were unreliable.

topics.query: Which landing bucket does the TLE ingest gateway currently use?

statements.f1: The Telemetry decoder farm uses qrv-dq-kelmar as its dispatch queue. Workers claim packet batches from it by spacecraft family.
statements.f2: On 2026-04-09, the Telemetry decoder farm dispatch queue changed to qrv-dq-mirven to isolate decoder traffic from a congested broker partition.

topics.query: What is the Telemetry decoder farm's current dispatch queue?

statements.f1: The Azimuth drive controller position polling interval is 1180 ms. The console uses those samples to display antenna motion during a pass.
statements.f2: On 2026-05-14, the Azimuth drive controller position polling interval changed to 920 ms to make tracking deviations visible sooner.

topics.query: What is the Azimuth drive controller's current position polling interval?

statements.f1: The Mission operations console deployed release is qrv-moc-5.7.3. Operators use its pass timeline and decoder health panels during staffed contacts.
statements.f2: On 2026-06-03, the Mission operations console deployed release changed to qrv-moc-4.6.2 after a compatibility issue with the station display adapters.

topics.query: Which release is currently deployed for the Mission operations console?

statements.f1: The Beacon packet archive retention period is 63 days. Archived packets remain searchable by spacecraft and ground-station pass.
statements.f2: On 2026-01-27, the Beacon packet archive retention period changed to 42 days to reduce duplicate storage after the analytics copy was verified.

topics.query: What is the current packet retention period for the Beacon packet archive?

statements.f1: The Ranging reconciliation job starts daily at 02:39 UTC. It compares station measurements with the prior day's contact records.
statements.f2: On 2026-03-25, the Ranging reconciliation job daily start time changed to 03:46 UTC to avoid overlap with the measurement import.

topics.query: At what time does the Ranging reconciliation job currently start each day?

statements.f1: The Contact plan exporter uses qrv-windowloom as its rendering tool. It produces the station-facing plan from approved contact windows.
statements.f2: On 2026-07-08, the Contact plan exporter rendering tool changed to qrv-slotcaster to fix pagination of overlapping contacts.

topics.query: Which rendering tool does the Contact plan exporter currently use?

statements.f1: The Element freshness monitor stale-element alert threshold is 70 min. It checks the latest accepted element set for each tracked spacecraft.
statements.f2: On 2026-02-05, the Element freshness monitor stale-element alert threshold changed to 40 min after delayed ingest obscured a tracking risk.

topics.query: What is the Element freshness monitor's current stale-element alert threshold?

statements.f1: The Ground station outage notifier sends alerts to qrv-ops-pulsar as its notification channel. Messages include station ID and incident status.
statements.f2: On 2026-04-21, the Ground station outage notifier notification channel changed to qrv-station-ember to separate station incidents from routine operations traffic.

topics.query: What is the current notification channel for the Ground station outage notifier?

statements.f1: The Uplink command audit view dashboard is named qrv-panel-estuary. It groups command acknowledgements by spacecraft and operator session.
statements.d: The Uplink command audit view links each issued command to its approval record and downlink acknowledgement when available.

topics.query: What is the dashboard name for the Uplink command audit view?

statements.f1: RF chain calibration uses qrv-cal-lumet as its calibration service. Technicians attach sweep results to the relevant station work order.
statements.d: RF chain calibration records ambient temperature with each sweep so later comparisons account for equipment conditions.

topics.query: Which calibration service does RF chain calibration use?

statements.f1: Command signing key rotation runs on a cadence of 49 days. The custodian records each completed rotation in the access ledger.
statements.d: Command signing key rotation requires a second custodian to verify the new public-key fingerprint before activation.

topics.query: What is the cadence for Command signing key rotation?

statements.f1: The S band downlink modem active demodulation profile is qrv-sb-alten. It is used for routine beacon capture at staffed stations.
statements.f2: On 2026-05-06, the S band downlink modem active demodulation profile changed to qrv-sb-brevix for a trial of improved weak-signal acquisition.
statements.f3: On 2026-05-19, the S band downlink modem active demodulation profile reverted to qrv-sb-alten after the trial produced unstable frame lock.

topics.query: Which demodulation profile is currently active on the S band downlink modem?

statements.f1: The Cross station handover contact guard interval is 14 seconds. The scheduler leaves that gap between adjacent station assignments.
statements.f2: On 2026-06-11, the Cross station handover contact guard interval changed to 17 seconds to allow more time for antenna release.
statements.f3: On 2026-06-23, the Cross station handover contact guard interval returned to 14 seconds after controller timing measurements showed the extra margin was unnecessary.

topics.query: What is the current contact guard interval for Cross station handover?

statements.f1: The Emergency uplink relay failover host is qrv-jexora.qrv.invalid. Operators use the relay only when the normal uplink path is unavailable.
statements.f2: On 2026-07-02, the Emergency uplink relay failover host changed to qrv-zunara.qrv.invalid during maintenance on the previous host.
statements.f3: On 2026-07-10, the Emergency uplink relay failover host returned to qrv-jexora.qrv.invalid after maintenance and link checks were completed.

topics.query: What is the current failover host for the Emergency uplink relay?
